context: Adult resting reference envelopes used for external-scale checks; these are not a single matched clinical cohort and are not patient-specific calibration data.

cardiac_output_l_min.source: Rusinaru et al., Am J Cardiol 2021, DOI 10.1016/j.amjcard.2020.10.046
cardiac_output_l_min.note: Sex-specific non-obese adult normal limits span 3.3-8.2 L/min across female/male limits.

cv_ejection_fraction.source: Harkness et al., Echo Res Pract 2020; normal LVEF defined >=55%
cv_ejection_fraction.note: Upper bound is an engineering envelope, not a diagnostic cutoff.

ph_arterial.source: Yee et al., Fundamentals of Arterial Blood Gas Interpretation, 2022

paco2_mmHg.source: Yee et al., Fundamentals of Arterial Blood Gas Interpretation, 2022

pao2_mmHg.source: adult reference envelope used in ABG reviews; PaO2 is age-dependent
pao2_mmHg.note: Used only as a broad adult external-scale check.

gfr_ml_min.source: KDIGO 2024 CKD framework plus engineering upper envelope
gfr_ml_min.note: KDIGO is indexed to 1.73 m2 and does not define 90-140 as a universal healthy range; this is a robustness envelope for the nominal 70-kg scaffold.
